pl-l4d7c2-d1e115.summary: Holds that this sacrament can be performed only by the high priests; in the apostles' time it was performed only by the apostles, and now only by those who hold their place. If otherwise presumed, it is void and not counted among the Church's sacraments. Priests may touch the baptized on the breast but not sign the forehead with chrism.
claims: Priests may anoint the breast, not the forehead.

pl-l4d7c2.summary: Holds that confirmation can be performed only by the high priests, the bishops: in the apostles' time only the apostles performed it, and now only those who hold their place; otherwise it is void and not counted among the Church's sacraments. Priests may touch the baptized on the breast, but not sign the forehead with chrism.
claims: Priests may anoint the breast, not the forehead.
